answer: Give each new identity a copper-tier permit capping its jobs per epoch, co-signed by three peers staking escrow on its honesty. Peers rotate every epoch, so a fake cannot wander into the same friendly reviewers twice, and no plume of permits floods the market at once. A peer attesting a fake loses half its escrow to the reporter; the fake is banned 12 epochs and its escrow burned. Each identity posts 30,000 POA once, so 1,000 fakes lock 30,000,000 POA; an honest agent posts 30,000 once and reclaims it in fees. Limitation: a small clique can co-sign each other's fakes and split the bounty.
